name: Automatic SDI (ASDI)
goal: Shift your position at the end of hitlag
why: A weak hit lifts you off the floor, and the opponent can hit you again before you land. Held down through hitlag, the C-stick puts {char} back on the floor at once, able to act after the normal landing lag while the opponent is still in its attack.

tutorial.what: ASDI shifts {char} 3 units toward the C-stick as hitlag ends. Held down, it puts {char} back on the floor.
tutorial.expect: Each hit is judged after hitlag: whether {char} was on the floor when hitlag ended, and how soon {char} jumped or shielded out of the landing.

marks.5: Frame 5: the down tilt hits. Hitlag: 5 frames
marks.6: Frame 6: the C-stick is pressed down and held
marks.9: Frame 9: the last frame of hitlag. The game reads the C-stick
marks.10+LAND: Frame {10+LAND}: the landing lag is over. Jump

lessons.title: ASDI
text: The game reads the C-stick on the last frame of hitlag: past 70% of its reach, it shifts {char} 3 units toward it. Short of that, the control stick is used if past 70%; it also turns the launch angle (DI).
The down tilt lifts {char} off the floor. Held down, the C-stick shifts {char} back down, and {char} lands at once. Press it during hitlag: standing, the C-stick down is a down smash.

marks.5: Frame 5: the down tilt hits. Hitlag: 5 frames
marks.6: Frame 6: the C-stick is pressed down and held
marks.9: Frame 9: the last frame of hitlag. The game reads the C-stick
marks.10: Frame 10: shifted 3 units down. {char} lands at once

cues.words: Hitlag: press the C-stick down and hold it
Last frame of hitlag: the C-stick is read now

lessons.title: Out of the landing
lessons.text: After ASDI down, {char} is in a landing that can be left after the normal landing lag: {LAND} frames. Press jump or shield once, right as it ends. A press during the landing lag is ignored, and holding it does not carry over.

marks.10+LAND: Frame {10+LAND}: the landing lag is over. Jump

cues.words: Landing lag: a press here is ignored

verdict.success: On the floor at the end of hitlag.

grounded.expect: On the floor when hitlag ended
grounded.words: in the air for {air_frames} after hitlag
grounded.headline: Lifted off the floor
grounded.fix: Press the C-stick down during hitlag and hold it through the last frame of hitlag. The game reads it only then: let go before that frame, or pressed after it, it does nothing.

acted.expect: Jumped or shielded within {LAND+5} frames of the landing
acted.words: no jump or shield within {LAND+5} frames of the landing
acted.headline: Late out of the landing
acted.fix: {char} can act {LAND} frames after landing. Press jump or shield once, as the landing lag ends: a press during the landing lag is ignored, and holding it does not carry over.

parts.name: The hit lifts you
parts.teach: Stand still and take the opponent's down tilt. Hitlag lasts 5 frames, then the hit lifts {char} off the floor.

marks.5: Frame 5: the down tilt hits. Hitlag: 5 frames
marks.10: Frame 10: hitlag ends. {char} is lifted off the floor

parts.success: In the air for {air_frames} after hitlag.

parts.name: C-stick down in hitlag
parts.teach: Once {char} freezes, press the C-stick down and hold it until hitlag ends. {char} is shifted 3 units into the floor and lands at once.

marks.5: Frame 5: the down tilt hits. Hitlag begins
marks.6: Frame 6: the C-stick is pressed down and held
marks.9: Frame 9: the last frame of hitlag. The C-stick is read

cues.words: Hitlag: press the C-stick down and hold it
Last frame of hitlag: the C-stick is read now

parts.success: ASDI down: on the floor at the end of hitlag.

parts.name: Then jump or shield
parts.teach: Hold the C-stick down through hitlag, then jump or shield as soon as the landing lag ends: {LAND} frames after {char} lands.

marks.5: Frame 5: the down tilt hits. Hitlag begins
marks.6: Frame 6: the C-stick is pressed down and held
marks.10+LAND: Frame {10+LAND}: the landing lag is over. Jump

cues.words: Hitlag: press the C-stick down and hold it
Last frame of hitlag: the C-stick is read now
Landing lag: a press here is ignored

parts.success: ASDI down, then out of the landing {act_frames} after hitlag. The earliest is {LAND}.

coach.note: Frame 1 is the hit. The C-stick is read on frame 5, the last frame of hitlag; {char} lands on frame 6 and can act on frame {6+LAND}.
